paragraphs.text: He reproaches man for his ingratitude, seeing the heavens, which are dumb creatures, set forth God's glory.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: heavens declare the glory of God

paragraphs.text: The continual success of the day and night is sufficient to declare God's power and goodness.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: The heavens are a schoolmaster to all nations, no matter how barbarous.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: The heavens are as a line of great capital letters to show God's glory to us.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: line is gone out through all

paragraphs.text: Or vail. The custom was that the bride and bridegroom would stand under a vail together, and after come forward with great solemnity and rejoicing of the assembly.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Though the creatures cannot serve, yet this should be sufficient to lead us to him.
paragraphs.label: f
paragraphs.anchor: law of the LORD is perfect

paragraphs.text: So that all man's inventions and intentions are lies.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: Unless God's word is esteemed above all worldly things, it is contemned.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: For God accepts our endeavour though it is far from perfect.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Then there is no reward of duty, but of grace: for where sin is, there death is the reward.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: Which are done purposely and from malice.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: If you suppress my wicked affections by your Holy Spirit.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: That I may obey you in thought, word and deed.
paragraphs.label: o
